'''Ory Lam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. At one point in history, his career brought him to [[Kaas City]], the capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] for the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] in the [[Grand Melee]].<ref name="TOR" />
